collections.name: Joseph's Personal Kit
collections.author: Joseph Hill
collections.description: My personal curated collection of tools, prompts, books, videos, articles and a conference I've found valuable for product management and personal development. Time reflection, job reflection, breadboarding, Shape Up, leadership videos, and more.

collections.name: Product Discovery Essentials
collections.author: Joseph Hill
collections.description: A curated selection of the best prompts, skills, and tools for running continuous product discovery — from framing research questions to synthesising findings into opportunities.

collections.name: Product Strategy Playbook
collections.author: Joseph Hill
collections.description: Frameworks and practices for moving beyond feature delivery into outcome-driven product strategy — opportunity trees, decision logs, pre-mortems, and strategic narratives.

collections.name: AI for Product Managers
collections.author: Joseph Hill
collections.description: Practical prompts and workflows for using AI effectively throughout the product lifecycle — from customer research synthesis to brief writing and stakeholder updates.
